description: Plot data on a world map

configuration.name: accountId
configuration.title: Account ID
configuration.description: Account ID to be associated with the query

configuration.name: markersQuery
configuration.title: Markers query
configuration.description: Query to gather markers

configuration.name: markerAggregation
configuration.title: Marker aggregation
configuration.description: How should clustered markers be treated

configuration.name: markerColors
configuration.title: Marker colors
configuration.description: A comma separated list of hex colours in the order: cluster,no-status,ok,warning,critical

configuration.name: heatMapStepsMarkers
configuration.title: Markers heatmap steps
configuration.description: The number of steps in the heat map gradient. Empty or 0 disables heat map.

configuration.name: regionsQuery
configuration.title: Regions query
configuration.description: Query to gather reqgions

configuration.name: heatMapSteps
configuration.title: Region heatmap steps
configuration.description: The number of steps in the heat map gradient. Empty or 0 disables heat map.

configuration.name: regionColors
configuration.title: Region colors
configuration.description: A comma separated list of hex colours. Used to create heatmap or control threshold coloring. For critical/warning states provide no-status,ok,warning,critical

configuration.name: defaultSince
configuration.title: Default since/until clause
configuration.description: The since/until to use if no time picker value is chosen

configuration.name: ignorePicker
configuration.title: Ignore time picker
configuration.description: Dont adjust the query based on selected time picker

configuration.name: zoom
configuration.title: Default Zoom
configuration.description: Zoom level for the map

configuration.name: disableClusterZoom
configuration.title: Disable cluster at zoom
configuration.description: Zoom level at which to disable clustering

configuration.name: noWrap
configuration.title: Toggle map tile repetition
configuration.description: Enable to prevent map tiles from repeating horizontally when panning, creating a bounded map experience.

configuration.name: centerLatLng
configuration.title: Center lat,lng
configuration.description: Center of the map. Privide as lat,lng value

configuration.name: fetchInterval
configuration.title: Fetch interval (s)
configuration.description: Zero for no refresh, default is 5 minutes

configuration.name: thresholdQuery
configuration.title: Threshold query (optional)
configuration.description: Optional query to determine marker and region thresholds. Must return 'threshold_critical', 'threshold_warning', and the match field.

configuration.name: thresholdMatchField
configuration.title: Threshold match field
configuration.description: Field name used to match threshold data to markers and regions (default: 'name')

configuration.name: thresholdIgnorePicker
configuration.title: Threshold query ignore time picker
configuration.description: Don't adjust the threshold query based on selected time picker

configuration.name: thresholdDefaultSince
configuration.title: Threshold query default since/until clause
configuration.description: The since/until to use for threshold query if time picker is ignored

configuration.name: enableHistoricalThresholds
configuration.title: Enable historical thresholds
configuration.description: Use historical data to calculate dynamic thresholds instead of static threshold overrides

configuration.name: historicalPeriods
configuration.title: Historical periods count
configuration.description: Number of previous periods to query for historical threshold calculation (e.g., 7 for 7 previous days)

configuration.name: historicalPeriodSize
configuration.title: Historical period gap size
configuration.description: Gap between each historical period (e.g., 7 for weekly comparison, 1 for consecutive days)

configuration.name: historicalPeriodUnit
configuration.title: Historical period unit
configuration.description: Time unit for historical period gaps

configuration.name: historicalAggregation
configuration.title: Historical aggregation method
configuration.description: How to combine threshold values from multiple historical periods

configuration.name: showThresholdsInTooltips
configuration.title: Show thresholds in tooltips
configuration.description: Display warning and critical threshold values in marker and region tooltips

configuration.name: showHistoricalValuesInTooltips
configuration.title: Show historical values in tooltips
configuration.description: Display aggregated historical values in marker and region tooltips (requires historical thresholds and threshold tooltips to be enabled)

configuration.name: disableTimezoneAwareness
configuration.title: Disable daylight saving time handling
configuration.description: Use legacy timestamp arithmetic that may cause incorrect comparisons during daylight saving time changes. When disabled (default), ensures historical periods use the same local time regardless of clock changes.
